summary: Updates the track-path display in the UI. Resolves the stored path at this[87] (falling back to the default path byte_5EA438 when null), compares it with the current track path dword_7CE5D0, and when the stored path is null, empty or mismatched, pushes the current path through the vtable +176 callback. When session mode dword_7C569C and dword_7D0410 both equal 5 (championship server) and this[84] is set, it invokes the vtable +60 callback and raises byte_7CFF48. Ends with HitTest.

operations.description: Resolve the stored path this[87] with fallback to byte_5EA438 when null, and compare it against the current track path dword_7CE5D0 (also defaulted) via sub_588410.
When the stored path is null or empty, or does not match the current track path, fall through to the path-update callback.
Update the displayed track path by invoking the vtable +176 callback with the resolved current track path.
Championship-server condition: dword_7C569C == 5 and dword_7D0410 == 5 and this[84] (offset 0x150) is set.
When the championship-server condition holds, invoke the vtable +60 callback with argument 1 to raise the notification.
Set the flag byte_7CFF48 to 1 alongside the championship-server notification.
HitTest(this) runs the UI hit test on the object.
